label: Norway: Stavanger apart from Bergen

gate_relax.drive_factor_median: fjord county: roads round the fjords and ferries make drives about twice the straight line, as Vestland's (vea) relaxation; T-4364 split Rogaland from it

why: Bergen's zone (vea, shown Bergen) is Vestland and Rogaland, two fylker with their own cities 160 km apart across fjords; Rogaland (Stavanger, Sandnes, Haugesund; 0.44M) becomes its own zone svg, shown Stavanger, and vea keeps Vestland (0.56M). Rogaland is under the 0.5M floor but holds 88% of it, more than six of Norway's ten other zones.
